description: This file provides VML (Vector Markup Language) support for the Leaflet library, including functions for creating VML elements, a mixin for handling VML-specific SVG methods, and methods for managing VML layers and styles, primarily for backward compatibility with older Internet Explorer versions.

methods.name: _initContainer
methods.description: Initializes the container element for VML layers.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates the VML layer, calling the parent Renderer update if not animating.

methods.name: _initPath
methods.description: Initializes a VML shape and path for a given layer.

methods.name: _addPath
methods.description: Adds a VML layer to the container and sets up interactivity if needed.

methods.name: _removePath
methods.description: Removes a VML layer from the DOM and cleans up.

methods.name: _updateStyle
methods.description: Updates the style of a VML layer, including stroke and fill properties.

methods.name: _updateCircle
methods.description: Updates the VML representation of a circle shape.

methods.name: _setPath
methods.description: Sets the path data for a VML layer.

methods.name: _bringToFront
methods.description: Brings a VML layer to the front.

methods.name: _bringToBack
methods.description: Sends a VML layer to the back.
